name: OpenTable API
tagline: Partner API for restaurant search, availability, and reservation booking.
description: OpenTable's platform APIs let approved partners search restaurants, check table availability, and create or manage reservations. Access is partner-gated rather than fully self-serve; authentication and endpoint roots depend on the integration program (guest center, booking, or marketplace). Docs live on platform.opentable.com for onboarding and product coverage.

auth.details: Partner/program credentials; self-serve public API key signup not confirmed from public docs

pricing.paid_plans: Partner/commercial pricing; public self-serve tiers not published

use_cases: search restaurants by location or cuisine
check table availability for a party size and time
create or cancel a restaurant reservation
retrieve restaurant details and booking policies
